{{Quote|A thousand Jedi died cursing Darth Desolous.|Darth Desolous|<ref name="TFU">{{TFU|version=[[Wikipedia:PlayStation Portable|PSP]], [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 2|PS2]] and [[Wikipedia:Wii|Wii]]}}</ref>}}
At some point after [[3522 BBY]], a '''conflict''' was sparked between the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the forces of the [[Pau'an/Legends|Pau'an]] [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Desolous]]. A [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] expelled from the Order for studying [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] teachings, [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Desolous swore revenge on the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], assembled an [[Darth Desolous's army|army]] of Pau'an [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]], and trained them in his [[Darth Desolous's martial art|personal style of martial arts]]. His forces [[Death/Legends|killed]] nearly two thousand [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]], until Desolous and his [[Army/Legends|army]] were finally defeated by a Jedi strike force during a [[Battle of Yaga Minor (Darth Desolous conflict)|battle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yaga Minor/Legends|Yaga Minor]].

==Prelude==
Sometime after [[3522 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> a [[Pau'an/Legends|Pau'an]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] was expelled from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] for studying [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] teachings and falling to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. Angered at his expulsion, the individual became the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Desolous]] and swore revenge on the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. He assembled an [[Darth Desolous's army|army]] of Pau'an [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]] and trained them in his [[Darth Desolous's martial art|personal style of martial arts]]. The style combined the usage of a melee weapon with a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]-resistant [[Cortosis shield/Legends|cortosis shield]]; the shield was used to block an opponent's attack, leaving the being open for a quick counterattack.<ref name="TFU databank" />

==The conflict==
{{Quote|It took the entire Council to kill me, boy.|Darth Desolous|<ref name="TFU" />}}
[[File:DarthDesolousface.png|thumb|right|200px|Darth Desolous, the instigator of the conflict]]
Desolous led the Pau'ans in a series of ambushes against [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], [[Death/Legends|slaughtering]] almost two thousand Jedi. With each successful murder, Desolous grew more reckless and bold, and the Jedi decided to exploit those traits. A small force of Jedi Knights was sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yaga Minor/Legends|Yaga Minor]], acting as bait for the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], while a large Jedi [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] remained hidden nearby. When Desolous and his army [[Battle of Yaga Minor (Darth Desolous conflict)|struck]] the Jedi on the planet, the fleet emerged from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and prevented the Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lord's]] forces from retreating. Caught into a tactically disadvantageous position, Desolous's men were all killed, and Desolous himself was struck down.<ref name="TFU databank" />

==Legacy==
{{Quote|I am more powerful in death than I was in life!|Darth Desolous's simulacrum|<ref name="TFU" />}}
As [[Time/Legends|time]] passed, Darth Desolous's original name was forgotten, but his Sith name became synonymous with hatred and anger. A simulacrum of Desolous was later incorporated into the [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Jedi Trials program]] for [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The life-like manifestation could appear in the [[Jedi Trials chamber|Trials chamber]] during the "Trial of Skill," and was meant to test an apprentice's ability to overcome raw emotions.<ref name="TFU databank trial of skill">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' video game]] {{C|[[Wikipedia:PlayStation Portable|PSP]], [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 2|PS2]] and [[Wikipedia:Wii|Wii]] versions' in-game databank}}
 '''Trial of Skill''' entry.</ref> The simulacrum of Desolous was aware of his physical death; it took pride in the murders the real Desolous had committed and claimed that it had required the entire [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] to kill him.<ref name="TFU">{{TFU|version=[[Wikipedia:PlayStation Portable|PSP]], [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 2|PS2]] and [[Wikipedia:Wii|Wii]]}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This conflict was mentioned in the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 2|PlayStation 2]], [[Wikipedia:Wii|Wii]], and [[Wikipedia:PlayStation Portable|PlayStation Portable]] versions of the [[2008]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]'', developed by [[Krome Studios]]. The conflict was detailed in the game's databank entry on Darth Desolous.<ref name="TFU databank" /> In the game itself, the player, controlling the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Galen Marek|Starkiller]], faces against the simulacrum of Desolous inside the Jedi Temple. During the fight, the simulacrum exclaims random taunts and battle cries, and at one point claims that it required the entire Jedi Council to kill the real Desolous. Desolous's databank entry makes no mention of the Council; thus, the simulacrum's claim remains unconfirmed by any official source to date.<ref name="TFU" />
